model.state: completed 0.1s SE2 q, not instantaneous body velocity
model.memory: diagonal a, require 0<=a<1 after one least squares solve
model.knot_status: prospective engineering choices based on exposed observations; not measured deadzone boundaries
model.action_domain: original full [-1,1] x [-0.4,0.4] x [-1,1], no action clipping/filtering or compensation

data.role: previously exposed exploratory identification only, not independent unknown/final data
data.original_recovery_protocol: HELD remains HELD; only separately verified complete saved cases reused
data.sample_unit: whole trace/case; correlated ticks are not independent repetitions
data.navigation_initial_q: unknown pre-window q: exclude first fitting pair; zero only for diagnostic free prediction
data.probe_initial_q: actual warmup 180/200 endpoints; include first measurement transition
data.partial_interval: exclude incomplete fitting pairs, retain all physics ticks in free prediction

folds.navigation: leave one whole map level out, all six repeated/method cases together
folds.objective: 0.5 navigation cohort + 0.5 controlled cohort; equal traces within each cohort, equal rows within trace
folds.solves: exactly one ordinary weighted least squares per fold/axis, rcond=1e-12; at most nine

diagnostics.free_prediction: align initial pose/q once, then only fixed model and saved actual commands; no truth correction
diagnostics.baselines: same-fold previously saved affine model and ideal command model; no baseline refitting
diagnostics.saved: axis solutions/singular values, train/heldout identities, 30 per-case metrics, predictions and time prefixes
diagnostics.fit_stop: rank<6, condition>1e8, nonfinite or a outside [0,1): save HELD and stop, no clipping/retry
candidate_checks: navigation aggregate and each of three maps position RMSE no worse than old affine
controlled position RMSE strictly lower than both old affine and ideal command
controlled terminal heading MAE no worse than old affine
M01 and M02 each position RMSE no worse than ideal command
diagnostics.pass_meaning: screening diagnostic only; not new alpha/delta, 90s applicability, navigation success, NAV043 or G5

support.status: rank 6/6 on all nine weighted design matrices; condition about 51.1 to 88.3, no coefficient solves
support.limitation: full column rank does not prove q Markov sufficiency or full action/state domain coverage

once_only.refusal: missing approval/readiness, changed pins, existing output or lock; before any new data fitting/marker

next_dependencies: main-agent saved-output verification with no new solve
review diagnostic result and motion-state support before model selection or production integration
executable reference command program and frozen-power J evaluation, not L/90 or time doubling
separate new 90-second residual/physical scope, calibration review and affected learning/deployment gates
